author: ResilientCyber
text: The Fireworks AI incident update reads like a case study in AI supply chain risk. Fireworks first disclosed on October 9 that attackers used internal credentials to capture API keys and tokens stored as secrets in customer evaluation jobs.

author: MagicRental
text: CISA KEV & Critical Web Template Vulnerability (CVE-2026-87902): WordPress Core page template path traversal to RCE.

author: liher0505
text: CVE-2026-119977 is being exploited in the wild; on an unpatched WordPress site the update itself opens the door. Back up, block /wp-content/upgrade, then update.

author: newswithai_hq
text: CISA added GPUStack flaw CVE-2026-102895 to its exploited list. Before 2.2.0, a request that looks like it came from localhost, e.g. via a same-host proxy, gets admin with no login. Upgrade to 2.2.0.

author: CipherSecurityN
text: AI inference firm Fireworks AI says attackers reached some customers' datasets, incomplete model weights and billing details (no card numbers) via a breach at a third-party cloud host, per Bloomberg and Forbes. Its second incident since Oct 6.

author: infrastack_ai
text: The npm package @bestcoolman/dev-mcp contains malicious code, per a new advisory. If you installed it or ran it as an MCP server, remove it and rotate the credentials it could reach.

author: linklin63793
text: Claude Code 2.1.321 (Nov 9 changelog): fixed MCP OAuth sending secrets such as refresh tokens to another host when a server redirected them. Also fixed a read-only Bash path that could skip the sandbox.

author: HotaSamit
text: IBM has addressed a critical authorization bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-123218) in Aspera Faspex that allows unauthenticated privilege escalation; now in CISA KEV.

author: infrastack_ai
text: AWS mitigated Redshift and the EKS control plane for CVE-2026-98432, a Linux TCP remote code execution bug. Self-managed Linux hosts on EC2/Lightsail and EKS/ECS worker nodes: update the kernel and reboot, or livepatch. Disabling MPTCP reduces exposure.

author: aviatrixtrc
text: Attackers exploited CVE-2026-123158 (SSHole) within 40 hours of disclosure, bypassing OpenSSH authentication on musl-based Linux systems, escalating to root, and deploying a Python-based C2 implant (TAC Agent) to harvest cloud credentials.

author: infrastack_ai
text: AWS patched Lambda and Amplify Node.js runtimes for Node2Shell, the Brotli RCE, and shared a WAF rule. Rebuild and redeploy Lambda container images.

author: MacroWireIntel
text: France blames Iran for a cyberattack on supermarket refrigeration systems; a breach at Japan's Iris Ohyama exposed 7.7 million customers.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: IRGC-linked CyberAv3ngers attributed to two waves of cold-chain attacks across Europe, hitting hundreds of supermarkets and French blood storage facilities by exploiting unpatched, internet-exposed Danfoss refrigeration controllers.

author: Daily_CyberSec
text: CISA KEV Catalog adds CVE-2026-123158, CVE-2026-116779, CVE-2026-123218, and CVE-2026-102895 after attackers exploit these four flaws in the wild. #OpenSSH #FreeSWITCH

author: Soar_Infosec
text: SonicWall SSLVPN has an actively exploited authentication bypass, CVE-2026-19868. CISA added it to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities list on Nov 6. Check whether SSLVPN logins use SAML, then check the firmware build.

author: aviatrixtrc
text: Attackers stole CI credentials to hijack Ethersphere's own release pipeline, publishing malicious bee-js and Swarm Desktop packages signed with legitimate certificates and valid npm provenance. The backdoor's C2 address was encoded in an Ethereum smart contract.

author: CipherSecurityN
text: JUST IN: Google fixed a Chrome zero-day exploited in the wild. CVE-2026-125350 (high) is a use-after-free in XML. Fixed in 157.0.8103.50/.51 for Windows/Mac, .50 for Linux, and Extended Stable 156.0.8078.96. Update and relaunch.

author: EnclaveRadar
text: Public exploit released: CVE-2026-123807 (CVSS 9.8) signalk-server path traversal. Remote, no login needed.

author: D0xedDevi0
text: CVE-2026-58868: critical Android RCE, remote, no user interaction. Google shipped the patch.

author: threatroundup
text: Etugen found the Ivanti VPN zero-day operator's next proxy serving an open directory: exploit framework, 168 run logs and a Russian AI-agent memo naming every server swap.

author: gezgp
text: Attackers are now deploying autonomous agentic AI tools to find and abuse leaked cloud secrets from GitHub. API keys and client secrets are the first in line to get discovered.

author: traphabits101
text: Vanderbilt confirms an active cybersecurity incident Monday, tells campus to shut down devices and disconnect Wi-Fi; systems and cloud services at risk.

author: 1752vc
text:
NEW: AI inference provider Fireworks says hackers reached some customers' datasets and unfinished model weights in its second breach in weeks, this time through a cloud provider.

Source: Bloomberg

text:
A VPN that accepts one factor is a door with no second lock.

If on-call reaches alerts through that VPN, patch and test a second path.

author: BreachByteSec
text:
CISA added the Alpine OpenSSH bug (CVE-2026-123158) to its exploited list today, with a federal deadline of Nov 12. If you run Alpine or another musl distro with sshd exposed, patch and restart today, then check authorized_keys for keys you didn't put there.
#OpenSSH #KEV
